A '''loyalty microchip''' was a brain implant placed within the brain stem that would ensure loyalty to someone else. [[Jobril]] asked [[Nirama]] for this to be installed in him to show he would always be loyal to him and his company.<ref name="Dark on Dark">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20020712adark&c=swlfc|text=Dark on Dark}}</ref>
